paragraphs.text: A **cash-secured put** is a short put position in which the writer sets aside enough cash to buy the shares at the strike price if the put is assigned [S1]. The writer sells the put, collects the premium up front, and accepts the obligation to buy 100 shares per contract at the strike any time before expiration [S1]. The word *secured* refers to the cash: in a cash account the broker holds the full purchase price as collateral for the whole life of the trade [S1]. **Assignment** is the process by which an option writer is selected to fulfil the obligation of a contract that a holder has exercised [S2].

Buying power was split between cash-secured puts at {{allocation.csp_pct|pct}} of the strategy budget, LEAPS at {{allocation.leaps_pct|pct}}, and a cash reserve of {{allocation.cash_pct|pct}}, with a regime label of {{regime.label}} and a VIX reading of {{regime.vix}}. The screen sized {{counts.positions_sized}} positions, so the portfolio shows premium income of {{portfolio.premium_income|money}} and margin used of {{portfolio.margin_used|money}}.

A **poor man's covered call** is a two-leg position: a long, deep in-the-money LEAPS call and a short, near-term, out-of-the-money call on the same stock [S5]. Formally it is a **long call diagonal spread**, with different strikes and different expirations [S5]. **LEAPS** is the exchanges' name for listed options with more than a year until expiration [S3].

The good-to-own quality screen passed {{quality_screen.passed_count}} underlyings: {{quality_screen.passed_tickers|list}}. The screen excluded {{quality_screen.excluded_count}} underlyings, with no exclusion reasons listed. Trend coverage was a secondary signal only: the trend board's top-ranked entities were {{trends[0].ticker}}, {{trends[1].ticker}}, {{trends[2].ticker}}, {{trends[3].ticker}} and {{trends[4].ticker}}, none of which is on the good-to-own list, so all were skipped by the universe filter.

The bottleneck board is also a secondary signal: it re-orders quality-gated stocks and never adds one. The top layer by score was {{bottlenecks.layers[0].name}} with a score of {{bottlenecks.layers[0].score}} and thesis state {{bottlenecks.layers[0].thesis_state}}; {{bottlenecks.layers[1].name}} scored {{bottlenecks.layers[1].score}} with thesis state {{bottlenecks.layers[1].thesis_state}}; {{bottlenecks.layers[2].name}} scored {{bottlenecks.layers[2].score}} with thesis state {{bottlenecks.layers[2].thesis_state}}. The networking layer showed thesis state {{bottlenecks.layers[5].thesis_state}}, and {{bottlenecks.companies[4].ticker}} carried flags {{bottlenecks.companies[4].flags|list}}.

No positions were sized: the sizer left every candidate behind. The portfolio's realistic loss is {{portfolio.realistic_loss|money}}, and the account size is {{profile.account_value|money}}.
